correctness.rationale: The proof fixes the inclusive graph metric, n>=7, local orbit normalizations, every codimension-one free-face condition, every discrete-Morse matching, and critical-cell counts. A three-column locality lemma reduces all periods to finite orbit incidence data. The independent enumeration code replays the exact 53 collapse orbits and all 13 two-cell match orbits at n=7,...,20. The remaining edges form a single longitudinal cycle with trees, giving a 1-vertex/1-edge/2n-two-cell Morse CW model. The longitudinal projection maps a rim to the generator of VR_2(Cn)~=S1; this forces each integer attaching degree to vanish, and maps S1->S1 of degree zero are nullhomotopic. Thus the wedge follows without inferring an infinite proof from finite tests.

value.rationale: The width 6 equals the first critical transverse circumference 3k for radius k=2 and falls outside the >3k torus-stability regime. It differs from the 4-wide and 5-wide homotopy decompositions, producing exactly two independent 2-sphere classes per longitudinal column and preserving precisely one of two torus directions. The theorem resolves an infinite anisotropic boundary regime with an integral homotopy classification and a reusable finite orbit proof, rather than merely a small computed homology rank.
